title: Data Governance Analyst, Data Business Analyst, Data Quality Analyst, Professional Services
description:
Data Governance Analyst, Data Business Analyst, Data Quality Analyst, Power BI, Professional Services, City, London


Data Governance Analyst / Data Business Analyst required to work for an exciting Professional Services business based in the City of London. This will be a hybrid role where you will be required to be in the office 3 days per week and the rest from home.


We ideally need someone from a Professional Services background who has a Data Analysis background and has proven Senior Stakeholder Management skills. This is a department that is growing within the firm, so there is lots of opportunity to progress in the future. Read on for more details…


Skills Required:


  • 2 - 4 years’ relevant experience in data governance, business analysis or a closely related role.
  • A good understanding of data governance, data management, data quality and metadata principles.
  • Practical experience working with governance artefacts such as business data glossaries, data dictionaries, Critical Data Elements, data ownership matrices, systems of record and data quality rules.
  • Experience documenting business processes and data lineage, including how data is created, transformed, shared and used.
  • Strong business analysis and documentation skills, including producing user stories, use cases, functional requirements and reports.
  • Demonstrable Power BI experience, particularly creating visualisations and reports to support data governance activity.
  • Experience identifying and managing data-related issues, ensuring actions are properly tracked, resolved and documented.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work with Data Stewards and colleagues across both business and technology functions.
  • The ability to support training, communications and guidance and encourage adoption of new data standards and governance processes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • A proactive, self-motivated and collaborative approach, with the ability to work independently when required.


This is a great opportunity and salary is dependent upon experience. Apply now for more details…
